title: Abstracts: NeurIPS 2024 with Weizhu Chen
description: Next-token prediction trains a language model on all tokens in a sequence. VP Weizhu Chen discusses his team’s 2024 NeurIPS paper on how distinguishing between useful and “noisy” tokens in pretraining can improve token efficiency and model performance. The post Abstracts: NeurIPS 2024 with Weizhu Chen appeared first on Microsoft Research .
